title: Disable Memory Compression
name: disable-memory-compression
warning: Recommended only for PCs with 16 GB or more of RAM.
modal: Disabling Memory Compression prevents CPU cycles from being spent compressing RAM pages during games like CS2. Recommended only if you have 16 GB+ RAM. Requires a restart.
description: Stops Windows from compressing idle memory pages in the background, reducing CPU overhead during gaming.
